quotes.text: Growing up on the sunny Gold Coast in Queensland, Dr Marek Ciarkowski spends his time working or with his family of wife and three dogs.

Riding shotgun with a close relative that was struggling with their health but being told that “there was nothing wrong” led me to learn organically the underpinnings of multiple health conditions, why they happen and how to help improve them.
If you’ve been told “everything looks normal” but you still don’t feel right, you’re not alone.
A second opinion with Dr Marek is for people who want a fresh set of eyes and a careful rethink.
We'll go through your story properly, review past results, look for patterns that may have been missed, and map out what's worth investigating next—without unnecessary tests or guesswork.
Complex problems need time. That's why these appointments are longer.
The goal is to understand what's driving things, explain it clearly, and build a step-by-step plan you can actually use—testing ideas, treating what we find, and adjusting as we learn more.
